description: Shipped Control Atlas changes a visitor can use, newest last. The pull request that ships a change adds its entry in the same commit; merged entries cite the merge commit, releases cite their tag. Read by the Pulse build (scripts/lib/pulse.mjs), never by a crawler.

releases.title: Control Atlas v1.0.2 released
releases.summary: The final v1 maintenance release: retired old link aliases, better Atlas map contrast and steadier mobile loading.

releases.title: Atlas map: a stable territory you can pin and share
releases.summary: Publications keep their place on the map, published connections show their evidence, and a shared view records the dataset it was made from.

releases.title: Evidence Matrix and five other working files reworked
releases.summary: The Evidence Expectation Matrix keeps SP 800-53A methods, CCIs and STIG/SRG counts beside your own columns; implementation and inheritance worksheets follow the selected baseline.

releases.title: Templates, Compare and Start Here go one step at a time
releases.summary: One step indicator across the three guided flows, and each step waits for your choice before moving on.

releases.title: Atlas starts with what you're working on
releases.summary: RMF & ATO, STIGs & SRGs, Zero Trust, CMMC & CUI, FedRAMP and more: each gathers the publications, steps, templates and guides for that work.
